title: Industrial Designer – Components
note: Vehicle interior and component design in Ford's Dearborn studios. Asks for 1+ year of design experience and a PDF portfolio.

facts.summary: Interior/product designer in Ford's Dearborn design studios working on advanced and production interior projects.
facts.duties: Sketch, render and build 3D digital models of interior concepts; explore human-centered interior experiences; coordinate with other designers; think across physical and digital.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in industrial or transportation design (or equivalent); 1+ year design experience incl. final product execution; strong 2D-to-3D form skills.
facts.apply: Apply on Ford careers site; PDF portfolio required.
